import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,types,unittest
def guard(event,args):
    if event.startswith("socket.") or event in {"subprocess.Popen","os.system","os.posix_spawn","os.fork","sqlite3.connect"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden external effect: "+event)
    if event=="open" and isinstance(args[0],str) and pathlib.Path(args[0]).name.startswith(".env"):
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden environment file")
    if event=="import" and str(args[0]).split(".")[0] in {"psycopg2","psycopg","docker","main"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden app/database/container import")
sys.addaudithook(guard)

def module_at(path,name):
    module=types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__=str(pathlib.Path(path).resolve())
    exec(compile(pathlib.Path(path).read_text(),path,"exec"),module.__dict__)
    return module

    cases=[{}]

        assert mark.name=="parametrize"
        cases=[{mark.args[0]:value} for value in mark.args[1]]
    for index,arguments in enumerate(cases):
        def run_case(function=function,arguments=arguments):
            monkeypatch=pytest.MonkeyPatch()
            try:
                if "monkeypatch" in function.__code__.co_varnames[:function.__code__.co_argcount]:
                    function(monkeypatch=monkeypatch,**arguments)

            finally:monkeypatch.undo()
        suite.addTest(unittest.FunctionTestCase(run_case,description=name+"["+str(index)+"]"))
